text:
maria: Quick sync — catalog launch checklist for the 3 new open models (Orchid-2, Azalea-13B, Cypress-7B). Owners please confirm status and any blockers.

sam: Orchid-2 (owner: sam) — perf profiles DONE for 512/1024 ctx, quantized to int8. Still need legal license blurb and final model-card screenshot. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Azalea-13B (owner: kevin) — waiting on compatibility test with our KV-cache path (seq len 2048). Infra says a small kernel fallback occurs at 120 tokens, causing ~30ms spike. Investigating.

olivia: Cypress-7B (owner: olivia) — license is permissive but we need attribution text per upstream. Also want to run a 24h canary on Dedicated before enabling hosted.

maria: @kevin can you paste the kernel log? want to see whether it's a model graph issue or runtime selector.

kevin: sure, log snippet:
```
[2026-05-12T10:23:02Z] model=Azalea-13B seq=2048 kernel=fast_attention fallback=kv_kernel_v2 reason=matmul_tile_mismatch
[2026-05-12T10:23:02Z] latency=148ms tokens=128
```
Looks like a matmul tiling mismatch on A100 kernels. Eduardo in eng-runtime looped in.

ashley: Legal update: Orchid-2 attribution sample approved. For Azalea-13B, upstream CLA requires a signed contributor list — legal-bot flagged missing entries. I can help collect names.

legal-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: Azalea-13B - missing contributor entries (3). Please provide full names + emails to legal@redwood.ai within 48h or model will be marked "license pending" in the catalog.

sam: I can reach out to the model maintainer, have the contact. Will ping them today.

maria: Great — timeline: we want catalog visible in beta on Wed (2 days). Canaries should start Tues midnight. If legal or runtime blocks persist, we should gate only Orchid-2 and Cypress-7B. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

olivia: Fine with gating. Cypress canary is short: 12h traffic slice at 5% on Dedicated. I can own the rollout if infra gives the green light.

kevin: Runtime fix estimate ~1 business day if Eduardo's patch merges. Fallback is safe but increases token cost ~8%. Recommend we proceed with Azalea gated behind canary until patch lands.

ashley: I'll get the contributor list by EOD. Also attaching suggested attribution text:
```
"Model Azalea-13B — provided under Apache-2.0 with contributors: ..."
```

maria: OK action items recap:
- sam: contact Azalea maintainer (legal entries) — ETA EOD
- ashley: finalize attribution copy + file with legal — ETA EOD
- kevin/eng-runtime: kernel patch PR and canary plan — ETA 1 business day
- olivia: canary orchestration for Cypress + Azalea gating config — ETA tomorrow morning
- build-bot: create canary job and smoke tests for 3 models

build-bot: Canary jobs created: jobs/canary/orchid-2, jobs/canary/cypress-7b. Azalea-13B gated (license pending). Smoke tests: basic prompt/responses, kv-cache warmup.

maria: Thanks team. If legal entries for Azalea come in, we'll aim to flip it into the beta pool Thursday morning. Ping this thread with any new blockers. :pray:

sam: pinged maintainer, they replied with names, forwarding now.

kevin: Eduardo's PR is up: https://git.internal.redwood/pulls/4123 — awaiting review.

olivia: Canary schedule set for Tue 00:30 UTC. I'll watch first 2 hours.

maria: Awesome. Closing loop — will post a launch update in #product once beta is live.
